headline: Huang rally fades: Nasdaq-100 -1.99%; PCE and GDP data out at 14:30 CET

what_happened.summary: Per the Cboe Daily Take 'Monday's Euphoria Ends with Tuesday's Hangover' (24 Nov), the Nvidia-led rebound faded as traders sold technology again and moved into defensive areas. FRED shows the Nasdaq-100 closed at 26214.17 (-1.99%). Cboe says Nvidia lost nearly 6% and is still down around 37% from its October high, and Anthropic fell 6.4% to $81.90, below its IPO price for the first time. The Cboe Macro Volatility Digest (week of 23 Nov) read the earlier spike as AI-specific rotation and positioning rather than broad macro de-risking. Unverified headlines this morning say Nasdaq futures are down more than 2% on renewed AI doubts and reports of fresh US tariffs, with core PCE and GDP due at 14:30 CET. The inputs contain no live prices, so this brief does not say where NQ trades.
what_happened.market_action: Cboe says the Nasdaq Composite lost 1.5%, the Nasdaq 100 fell 2%, and the Dow rose as investors swapped tech for healthcare, consumer and retail names. VIX closed at 26.36 (-0.98%) and VXN at 36.42 (+0.30%). COR1M was 24.62 (-4.13%), VVIX 114.07 and SKEW 139.16. The S&P 500 close for 24 Nov is not yet in FRED; the last print is 7237.17 on 23 Nov.
what_happened.macro: Official Treasury data for 24 Nov: 2-year 4.63%, 10-year 4.91% (-1.0 bp), 30-year 5.3% (+1.0 bp). The 10-year real yield was 2.79% on 23 Nov. The HY OAS was 3.63 pct pts on 23 Nov (-13.0 bp), a day stale. Polymarket (unofficial) prices a 25 bp December hike at 93.5%, 50+ bp at 2.5% and no change at 4.0%. The latest official PCE prints (Sep) are core 0.32% m/m and 3.12% y/y. Today's PCE, GDP and claims releases are not in the inputs yet. Oil data is stale to 17 Nov (Brent 92.94).
what_happened.geopolitics: Not covered by the sources for this session. A headline (unverified) mentions fresh US tariffs, and I cannot confirm it.
what_happened.company_news: Nvidia: Cboe lists unresolved questions (board investigation, China-spy allegations, the Megaspeed connection, a reported SEC probe and House hearings in early December). The Cboe post says Anthropic had heavy put buying in its Dec 70 puts (18 Dec expiry). Cboe launched KPI binary options on 23 companies. SEC filings: Alphabet 8-K on a C$6 billion notes offering (24 Nov), and a Meta 8-K on Class C share issuance during litigation (23 Nov).

driver_reason: Cboe attributes Tuesday's reversal to Nvidia and the AI ecosystem, with the old questions about AI spending and returns back. The Digest's finding of idiosyncratic, AI-theme vol rather than macro de-risking supports this, though today's PCE and GDP could change the balance.
leader_reason: The Nasdaq-100 minus S&P 500 gap was 2.13 pct pts on the last session with data (23 Nov) and 0.76 pct pts over five sessions. VXN minus VIX is 10.06 pts, so Nasdaq-100 vol is richer than the broad index. COR1M at 24.62, well off the 36.05 peak, fits rotation within the market rather than indiscriminate selling.

overlap_with_previous.echo_check: The AI-doubt theme is partly echo, because the same questions on spending and returns recur. Tuesday's close is new price evidence, though, and it supports Cboe's earlier warning that a rebound could be only a reset. The hike-pricing theme is echo with no new official evidence until today's PCE. The tariff headline is single-source, unverified and carries no weight.
